articles.title_en: International anti-tax avoidance, tax fairness and domestic tax compliance
articles.title_cn: 国际反避税、税收公平与国内企业税收遵从
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates how international anti-tax avoidance measures promote domestic firms' tax compliance by improving tax fairness, using the implementation of the Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS) project in China as a quasi-natural experiment. The BEPS project curtails multinationals' tax avoidance and elevates their tax burden, improving overall tax fairness. The expanded tax base also incentivizes tax authorities to mitigate enforcement inconsistencies and establish a fairer tax administration environment. In response to heightened tax fairness, domestic firms exhibit increased tax compliance. Following the BEPS project implementation, a one standard deviation increase in multinationals' market share is associated with a 0.49 percentage point (8.75%) decrease in domestic firms' book-tax differences. This study identifies the spillover effects of multinationals' tax avoidance on domestic firms' tax compliance and demonstrates a previously unexplored mechanism whereby international anti-tax avoidance measures influence government revenue.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究以中国实施税基侵蚀与利润转移（BEPS）项目作为准自然实验，考察国际反避税措施如何通过改善税收公平促进国内企业税收遵从。BEPS项目遏制跨国公司的避税行为并提高其税负，改善整体税收公平。扩大的税基也激励税务机关减少执法不一致，建立更公平的税收征管环境。面对税收公平的提升，国内企业表现出更高的税收遵从。BEPS项目实施后，跨国公司市场份额每增加一个标准差，国内企业的账面-税收差异下降0.49个百分点（8.75%）。本研究识别了跨国公司避税对国内企业税收遵从的溢出效应，并揭示了国际反避税措施影响政府收入的一个此前未被探索的机制。
